svg.title: northwind ER diagram (keys only)
svg.desc: Entity relationship diagram of the northwind database (keys only), in crow's foot notation. customer_customer_demo.customer_id references customers.customer_id. customer_customer_demo.customer_type_id references customer_demographics.customer_type_id. employee_territories.employee_id references employees.employee_id. employee_territories.territory_id references territories.territory_id. employees.reports_to references employees.employee_id. order_details.order_id references orders.order_id. order_details.product_id references products.product_id. orders.customer_id references customers.customer_id. orders.employee_id references employees.employee_id. orders.ship_via references shippers.shipper_id. products.category_id references categories.category_id. products.supplier_id references suppliers.supplier_id. territories.region_id references region.region_id.
svg.text: northwind: a specialty foods company's customers, orders, and products
